::: {#def-recurrence-relation}
#### Recurrence relation

A **recurrence relation** [@wikipedia_recurrence_relation]
is the recurrence of a recursively defined sequence (@def-recursive-sequence),
that is, its recursive rule (@def-recursive-definition) written as an equation,
which gives the term $a_n$ in terms of the $m$ terms $a_{n-1}, \ldots, a_{n-m}$ just before it,
for every integer $n \ge n_0 + m$.

:::
